scope: Bounded source/metadata feasibility design for native HF BF16 reference-only layer streaming. No weight payload, model construction, torch/CUDA execution, service action or equivalence result.
conclusion: No source-proven memory or mathematical impossibility for a fixed short 100-case text corpus. One-layer residency is a defensible scheduling hypothesis, not equivalence or a safe-load measurement. Full checkpoint download volume remains at least hundreds of GB even without a disk cache.

minimal_cpu_falsifier.cases: Batch size one, distinct cases of lengths 5, 64 and 65 to cover incomplete KPool tail and KDA chunk/padding boundary. Explicit all-valid boolean masks and positions. CPU only, eval/inference mode, native eager implementations, no optional hub kernels.
minimal_cpu_falsifier.comparison: Stock full text-model forward plus the same stock LM head versus layer-major traversal of separately owned/copied modules over the same cases. Compare parameter/buffer names, shapes, dtypes and bytes first; require finite bit-identical per-layer HC outputs, returned top-k state, final HC-head/norm outputs and complete logits. Use original per-case operation shapes in both arms.
minimal_cpu_falsifier.conversion_check: The same tiny witness must also pass through the stock glm5_next checkpoint conversion/dtype plan, with deliberately split expert gate/up/down and q/k/v-conv sources. A same-weights loop test alone does not test the real checkpoint loader. The enclosing native glm5_next model mapping is needed; a bare DecoderLayer or standalone glm5_next_text load must not silently omit that mapping.
minimal_cpu_falsifier.status: Proposed configuration from source; not instantiated or executed by reviewer.

source_constraints.requirement: Preserve [1,T,4,4096] HC streams, mask creation, positions, NoPE, every layer return, and final unweighted HC mean then RMSNorm. Explicit use_cache=False/past_key_values=None for full-prompt reference evaluation.
Retain native checkpoint renaming, expert MergeModulelist/Concatenate ordering, q/k/v convolution concatenation and strict FP32 dtype plan. Do not blanket-cast loaded modules to BF16.

Account for native PyTorch KDA decay mask [1,64,ceil(T/64),64,64,128] FP32 and equally shaped expression temporaries. Pin implementation choice; fused kernels are a separate matched execution path, not an automatic memory shortcut.
Native MLA expands KV and creates an S-by-S selection mask; eager attention also has heads-by-S-by-S score/probability workspace. Bound final chat-template length before admission.
Native text reference executes layers0..44. Layer45/MTP and text-unused vision payload must have explicit stock exclusion semantics, not missing-weight tolerance.

memory_arithmetic.limitations: These are individual live tensors, not peak estimates. Stock conversion may simultaneously hold source views, stacked tensors and packed outputs; shard-backed views must not retain all prior shards. Count verified RAM shard, CPU/GPU layer ownership, pinned parameter/activation staging, one in-flight case, output logits and allocator workspaces.

smallest_real_weight_next_step: Only after tiny stock-load/loop parity: contained, no competing large model, one actual maximum-size forward layer with one longest final-tokenized corpus case; preserve native math/conversion, measure complete peak ownership/workspace and verify every downloaded whole shard against pinned LFS SHA before exposing its tensors. Do not start a 100-case full teacher pass from the scalar layer+shard estimate.
reference_evidence_rules: Process all cases one at a time for each resident layer. Keep lossless rolling CPU HC activations and any returned state; persistent pinned transfer buffers and completion fences must protect both parameter and activation H2D paths.

Final LM head must evaluate the full vocabulary for each scored position. It is possible to preserve compact per-token truth log probability and top-1 evidence without retaining every full-vocabulary tensor on disk, but reduction precision and shifted input/target alignment must be fixed and independently verified.
Use independently hashed official BF16 checkpoint bytes, not reconstructed EXL3 weights. Match token IDs/templates/masks/positions and score windows exactly to the candidate.
Kimi-generated text can provide cases; its answers/logits are not the GLM teacher. Tiny CPU parity cannot establish full-size GPU or whole-model equivalence.
